rod_radius = rod_diameter / 2.0
thread_major_radius = rod_radius + thread_depth
thread_minor_radius = rod_radius - thread_depth
num_pts = 200
helix_pts = []
for i in range(num_pts):
    t = i / (num_pts - 1)
    angle = 2 * math.pi * t * (rod_length / thread_pitch)
    helix_pts.append(Vector(thread_major_radius * math.cos(angle), thread_major_radius * math.sin(angle), t * rod_length))

threaded_rod = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)
